dedupe_keys.name: traits de cote en charente maritime depuis le xixeme siecle

description: Traits de côte en Charente-Maritime depuis le XIXeme siècle is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. As part of a monitoring of the morphological evolutions of the Charente-Maritime coastline, at the request of the Charente-Maritime Departmental Council, a synthesis of the evolutions of the coastlines of the Île de Ré, the Île d'Oléron and the Presqu'île d'Arvert is carried out annually. Several rib traits have been digitized since 1824. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal features in Charente-Maritime since the 19th century" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Charente-Maritime; trait de côte;. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
